name: @absolutejs/errors
description: Sentry-equivalent exception capture for the AbsoluteJS substrate. createErrorTracker decorates @absolutejs/audit + @absolutejs/telemetry: captureException(error, context?) emits to audit, records on the active span, computes a stable fingerprint, and keeps an in-process recent-errors buffer. No vendor lock-in; the substrate owns the audit surface.
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --sourcemap --target=bun && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check:package: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test
scripts.release: bun run format && bun run check:package && bun publish
